rationale: Energy ceasefire claim for Ukraine-Russia war could ease regional threat if confirmed; Yandex strikes show continued tech escalation; Riyadh attacks threaten energy routes.

top_events.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
top_events.label: Trump claims energy ceasefire for Ukraine war
top_events.summary: US president announces energy ceasefire claim between Ukraine and Russia. Zelensky supports but Moscow has not commented, leaving regional security outlook uncertain.

top_events.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
top_events.label: Ukraine hits Yandex in third tech strike
top_events.summary: Third Ukrainian strike this week on Russian tech infrastructure forces Yandex to suspend operations, continuing escalation pattern near Romania's region.

top_events.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
top_events.label: Second Houthi strike hits Riyadh airport
top_events.summary: Repeated attacks on Saudi capital threaten Middle East energy infrastructure and shipping routes critical to EU energy security and Black Sea region.

short_summary: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills twelve people

most_significant_event.label: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills twelve people
most_significant_event.summary: Yemen's Houthis struck Riyadh airport killing 12 and injuring 309 in what Saudi coalition calls war crime. Threatens regional energy security and stability.
most_significant_event.title: Twelve killed in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
